spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.description: Transform any number of willing creatures into a Beast (CR 4-). As a Magic Action, change their forms again. Ends if HP drops to 0.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.description: 10ft Emanation suppresses all magic. Spells can't be cast, magic items become mundane, and summoned creatures disappear. Artifacts and deities are unaffected.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spells.description: Choose a type of intelligent creature. **Antipathy:** Chosen creatures within 60ft make a Wisdom save or are Frightened and must move away. **Sympathy:** Wisdom save or compelled to move toward target.

spells.name: Befuddlement
spells.description: Blast a creature's mind. Intelligence save or take 10d12 Psychic damage and Int becomes 1. Cannot cast, use items, or understand language. Repeat save every 30 days.

spells.name: Clone
spells.description: Grow duplicate in vessel (takes 120 days). If original dies, soul transfers to clone. Duplicate is physically identical with same memories.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.description: Change precipitation, temp, and wind within 5 miles. Conditions take 1d4x10 mins to change.

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.description: Shadowy door leads to 30ft Cube empty room. Can connect to previous demiplanes or a new one.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.description: Wisdom save or creature is Charmed. Telepathic link; can issue commands. Repeats save on damage.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description: 100ft-radius circle on ground is Difficult Terrain. Start of turns: Dexterity save or knocked Prone. Fissures or structures may collapse.

spells.name: Glibness
spells.description: Replace Charisma roll with 15. Truth-detecting magic indicates you are truthful.

spells.name: Holy Aura
spells.description: 30ft Emanation. Chosen creatures have Adv on saves; others have Disadv on attacks vs them. Fiend/Undead hitting them must save (Wisdom) or be Blinded.

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere (Heavily Obscured). Entering or starting turn in cloud: Dexterity save or 10d8 Fire damage (half on success). Moves 10ft/turn away from you.

spells.name: Maze
spells.description: Banish creature to labyrinthine demiplane (Incapacitated). Target escapes with DC 20 Intelligence check (Action).

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.description: Willing creature immune to Psychic damage, Charmed, and mind-reading/sensing (including Wish).

spells.name: Power Word Stun
spells.description: Word of power. If target has 150 HP or fewer, it is Stunned. Repeats Constitution save at end of turns to end.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.description: 60ft-radius Sphere burst. Constitution save or 12d6 Radiant damage + Blinded (1 min). Success: half damage and not blinded. Disadv for Undead/Oozes.

spells.name: Telepathy
spells.description: Link with one known willing creature on same plane. Share words, images, and sensory info instantly.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.description: Wall of water (300x300x50ft). Strength save or 6d10 Bludgeoning damage + swept up. Moves 50ft/turn next round, dealing another 5d10 damage.

spells.name: Abi-Dalzim’s Horrid Wilting
spells.description: Draw moisture in 30ft Cube. Constitution save or 12d8 Necrotic damage (half on success). Water/plant creatures have Disadv and take max damage on fail. Non-creature plants wither instantly.

spells.name: Illusory Dragon
spells.description: Create Huge shadowy dragon. Appearance: Wisdom save or Frightened (1 min). Bonus Action: move 60ft and exhale 60ft cone (Intelligence save or 7d6 Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Necrotic/Poison, half on success). Success on investigation reveals illusion.

spells.name: Maddening Darkness
spells.description: 60ft-radius Sphere of magical darkness (blocks Darkvision/L8- light). Starting turn in sphere: Wisdom save or 8d8 Psychic damage (half on success).

spells.name: Mighty Fortress
spells.description: Stone fortress erupts (120ft square area). Includes turrets (100ft high), keep, food for 100, and 100 phantom servants. Vanishes after 7 days unless recast. Permanent after 1 year of weekly casting.
